description: Express + whatsapp-web.js WhatsApp bot backend for Back4App

runtime.note: Node 22 provides native WebSocket (Supabase). A ws polyfill is also active in src/utils/supabase.js as a fallback.

persistence.purpose: Persist whatsapp-web.js LocalAuth session files so bots do not require re-pairing after each redeploy.

steps: Create a Back4App App and choose the Docker/container deploy type.
Point the deploy at the repo `whatsapp-bot-backend` (or upload the Dockerfile).
Set the required env vars listed above (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY, GEMINI_API_KEY).
Attach a persistent volume and mount it at /app/.sessions (or $WA_SESSION_DIR).
Expose port 10000 and set the health check path to /ping.
